Get governor of multan send fort villa to wood then rally to wood until enough for 2nd tc
At 450 wood send wood vills to stone
Send all stone vills to build 2nd tc when u can

Send all stone vills to build fort on gold
Once built fort on gold get governor of bukkar then remacro stone vills, one vill build house around fort and rally gold or stone if 3rd fort wanted
Pull food vills to age up
Age up with house of learning, rally food
Go for relics, start massing elephant raiders and archers, get upgrades for forts as well as if needed age up with palace of sultan going for governor of Mulan
